articles.title: This New Material Can Make Heat Go Where You Want — Like a Programmable Computer!
articles.summary: Scientists built a material that can control heat like a computer controls data. It can even remember its settings after you turn off the power. The device uses special materials and magnets to direct heat in different directions.

articles.title: Could Every American Get $320 from AI? OpenAI's Big Idea
articles.summary: OpenAI's boss Sam Altman wants to give the U.S. government a 5% share of the company. That could mean about $320 for every American household. The idea is to share the wealth AI creates, especially if it takes over many jobs.

articles.title: Ghost Particles Could Catch Sneaky Nuclear Weapons Makers!
articles.summary: Tiny particles called antineutrinos could help watch fusion reactors to make sure they aren't secretly making material for nuclear bombs. A mobile detector called MiniCHANDLER can spot the telltale signals from far away.
